name: Should I install PVC trim or tile baseboards in my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I install PVC trim or tile baseboards in my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile baseboards offer maximum water protection and easy cleaning, while PVC trim delivers a traditional carpentry look at a lower material and installation cost. Tile baseboards match or accent your tiled floor, completely resisting standing water, mop moisture, and shower splashes, making them ideal for high-traffic or wet-room setups. However, PVC trim provides classic architectural character, crisp painted lines, and easier adjustments if your walls are uneven. The tradeoff comes down to aesthetics versus utility: tile handles constant standing water effortlessly, whereas PVC provides a warm, seamless transition to painted walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile baseboards provide unbeatable water protection against puddles, while PVC offers the classic look of painted woodwork at a lower installation cost.
